_comment: aTAS clients by company code (what staff type on first open). CI publishes this file to the public repo bspchris/atas-download (main branch), where the app reads it. host = JET server, project = JET project, signupUrl = that project's form "aTAS Staff Sign-up" (the kiosk QR). forms (optional) = form ids, used only for an aTAS form JET doesn't list for a login; otherwise forms are found by name. Only addresses here: no passwords or keys.
